package ui

// The stand-in for video_pip_hooks_test.go on ui, which has no mini
// player: a playing video scrolled under 10% visible or left behind
// pauses, and the media viewer has no Dock to corner.

import (
	"image"
	"time"
)

type pipView struct {
	rect     image.Rectangle
	controls []image.Rectangle
	corner   string
	playing  bool
	elapsed  time.Duration
	trigger  string
}

func pipShown(*perfEnv) (pipView, bool) { return pipView{}, false }

func inlineInPip(*perfEnv, string) bool { return false }

func viewerDock(*perfEnv) image.Rectangle { return image.Rectangle{} }
